label: 0020 · Starter, 50 km BEL cut, Nankai remeshed (5 km elements at Hyuga-nada, 24 km at the trench) with a length scale that follows the element size, -20 floor after the 2024 Hyuga-nada earthquake, CMT catalog through May 2025, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: 0018 with the -20 floor of 0019 after the 2024-08-08 Hyuga-nada Mw 7.1, on a remeshed Nankai mesh whose Matern length scale follows the element size. The mesh is the same slab surface with 5 km elements around the Hyuga-nada rupture, 16 km elsewhere and 24 km at the trench (2358 triangles instead of 1902). The length scale is about 34 km at Hyuga-nada, 79 km elsewhere (as in 0018) and 107 km at the trench, with 79 modes. In Aug-Dec 2024 the afterslip forms a compact patch of about 3,700 km2 at 17-42 km depth, as in 0019 (3,500 km2 with a 30 km length scale on the whole mesh), and residual RMS within 100 km is 3.4 mm/yr (0019: 3.2; with the -20 floor and 79 km: 5.4). Unlike in 0019, Kii coupling stays at 0.51 (0019: 0.43). In a synthetic test the same mesh and prior recover a 30 km patch at the hypocenter about as well as 0019's prior (correlation 0.74 against 0.78). Before Aug 2024 the fit in every window is within 1.2% of 0018's (median 0.1% better) and Nankai coupling moves by a median of 0.27 posterior standard deviations. Block motion is that of 0012-0019 (reference solve reused).
